designationHistory.indexText: Established in 1972 when the U.S. Coast Guard transferred the north end of Thacher Island, off Rockport, Massachusetts, for migratory bird habitat.

authority.citation: Transfer from the U.S. Coast Guard

designationHistory.note: The refuge page gives only the month or year. The refuge page does not say how it was established.

sources.name: U.S. Fish and Wildlife Service: Thacher Island National Wildlife Refuge, About Us

National Historic Landmark nomination, Cape Ann Light Station (NPS, archived): the north side of Thacher Island "was transferred by the Coast Guard to the Bureau of Sport Fisheries and Wildlife" in 1972

review.note: Year confirmed by the NHL nomination.

designationHistory.indexOriginal: The refuge was established in 1972 to provide feeding, resting and nesting habitat for migratory birds, located approximately one mile off the coast of Rockport, Massachusetts.
